title: Query filtering by primary key and additional filter returns invalid results
body:
### Describe the bug

If one queries by primary key and an additional filter, then `findOne` sometimes returns invalid results.
Consider a Model that has a validity range. Filtering by the validity range is implemented by a mikro-orm `@Filter`. 
If one queries for one of such models by `id` with an additional filter condition, then the filter condition is respected on first query. However, on subsequent queries _different filter conditions_ no longer seem to be respected. It appears that the filter conditions are not taken into account when loading the model from the entity manager's memory. 

See the attached reproduction for a case where this leads to problems: the same query leads to different results depending on whether the entity in question has been queried for with a _different filter_. 

### Reproduction

https://github.com/mpauly-exnaton/mikro-orm-reproduction/blob/lookup-by-id-and-filter/src/example.test.ts

### What driver are you using?

@mikro-orm/postgresql

### MikroORM version

6.6.4

### Node.js version

v25.2.1, typescript@5.9.3

### Operating system

MacOS
